steps.name: Shinik's Call
steps.objective: Visit [Shainic] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You've been looking for it for a long time!! I told him to stay still and rest, so where on earth was he wandering?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. But what did you call me for?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: There's something you need to do. I will refuse rejection♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… , it can't be helped. I'm happy to cooperate.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: After all, you are fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But the city atmosphere is unusual. Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You figure it out right away, right? They started moving.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If they… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It looks like soldiers from the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos have set foot nearby.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So, I want you to go to Cali and tell me about this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cali?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, Carly. This is 'Kali', a village of the Kali people, one of Eastland's ethnic minorities.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: They are a clan with strong natural powers thanks to the blessings of heaven and earth. A long time ago, the Deimos Church hunted them for some reason.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So the Kali people abandoned their hometown and searched for a place to settle down, arriving on one side of Adrika, the land of welcome.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: With the help of Adkina, I settled down and have been living ever since. I have a feeling that the soldiers of the Holy Kingdom of Darkness are probably targeting the Kali people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. But it’s a bit surprising.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought Shinik would care about others... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Everyone on the continent hates the Deimos Church. So, if you make a pointless joke, I'll kill you♡, okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, okay. Don't kill me. Anyway, all I have to do is go and tell them, right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah. In Kali Village, there is also Medea, the superhuman you want to meet, so just say I sent you. Okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, that's right. There's something I have to do before that. Just in case, I sent my welcome to Adrica.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that illusion you want to beat up?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Did you really just say that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. It's nothing.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well, that's enough. My vision told me that there was someone wandering around Adrica. Go see that person on the way. He tells them that it will be safe if they go to Tartarus.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If you start wandering around the land of illusions where phantom beasts have disappeared, there are times when you will not be able to escape until you die. Okay? You have to say it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. By the way, which way should Kali go?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If you go to the west of Tartarus, you will see Adrika, the Land of Illusions. Just keep going.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Normally, Kali cannot be found unless you are a special person, but since you are the goddess' messenger, she will be found quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay. I'll just stay here and see you later. And later he… . Oh, it's already gone... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I can't help it. Let's leave it up to him to meet him... .

steps.name: lost girl
steps.objective: Defeat [Hungry Gradual] and [Dess] in “Adrica” and report to [Minuet].

lines.text: (A girl is wandering around with a blank expression. She seems to be the lost person Shinik was talking about.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, hey?
Woof… … … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey!!
Yes, yes?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't be alarmed! I'm not a strange person.
Among those who say they are not strange, there is no one who is not strange... .
I'll believe it! I'll believe it.
My name is Minuet. Please take care of me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (%s also tells you your name.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll introduce it here... . minuet. I'll show you the way, so go to a place called Tartarus.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, yes... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I'll clean up the place a little and clear the way. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You… , You have special powers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Special powers? Do you feel that way about me?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'm not sure exactly. It just felt that way.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Now that I think about it, why did I feel that way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . I'm a little embarrassed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He’s an interesting person.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm busy so I'll just leave. To get to Tartarus, go straight east, so be careful. Did you know?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes. thank you.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (As %s is about to leave, the wounds on Minuet's arms and legs come into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… . minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have serious wounds on my arms and legs. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It's sore, but it doesn't hurt that much. Still, this body seems very strong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This body?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: This body… ? Oh, why did I say that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you please explain how you got here?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: That… , I don’t remember… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I thought a lot about how to answer the question... , I have no idea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you lost?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'm not even sure about that. Still, I'm glad I'm not an idiot who doesn't even know your name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … You look so bright and out of place in this situation.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you. This is my first time hearing such a story!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As I watch the minuet, I feel a surge of anxiety that I didn't know existed before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, I'm so sorry. I'd like to go to Tartarus with Minuet, but I'm so busy right now that I don't think I'll have the time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go straight east and you will see the entrance to Tartarus. I'll organize things properly when I come, so nothing too dangerous will happen... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you still feel it's dangerous, come back here. Did you know?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I will. thank you. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then go carefully.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Stop there. What brought you here? A foreigner... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Are you on guard?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to tell you that soldiers from the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos appear to have appeared nearby... .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Got it. I'll just count it as delivered and go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it? You are so rude!! What if I just don't go back?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: I will make you pay for trespassing into this village.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: You wait… .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Not one, but two or three blessings from the goddess? What on earth are you doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Three? Not one, but two, three? I think Iris is obvious... . Are you Ceres? And what is one?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do you know that?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: I hate to admit it, but I have the ability to recognize that… .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: By the way, are you perhaps a messenger for a goddess from the western continent? ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah. Doing a little bit of goddess work. I came here to report a dangerous situation from Tartarus.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Tartarus? Shinik sent me here. Considering that they came straight to our village and not to the Valley of the Dragon, it is definitely a dangerous situation... .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Got it. Well, Merrymel knows where Medea is, so go there.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Merrymel is located in the center of town, so you can find it quickly. And there's a lot of junk around, but don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are kinder than I thought. I wish I could have said that a long time ago... .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: That only applies to outsiders. Oh, and thank you for the compliment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He's a strange guy. Then, let's go find someone named Merrymel...)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: … Even if I make it like this, there is no one in this town who will use it. Without Noel, there is no one to appreciate my things. Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this? I think it was really well made. As the person at the entrance to the village said, he looks really good with his hands.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: This is a feeding machine that automatically feeds the birds. Hehe, you're more dexterous than I look. But who? Outsider? Outsider? Foreigner?!

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Wow, I'm a foreigner!! Foreigner!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is this reaction? Do you like it? Do you hate it?)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Oh, come to your senses! Even if you don't see foreigners often, this is rude.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: What brought you here? Foreigner!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik of Tartarus told me to go to someone named Medea, so I came. Where is Medea?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Is there any reason why I should tell a foreigner?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not necessarily true... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would you like to give me something from overseas? There’s nothing I can do if you don’t like it, but… .

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Foreign stuff?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I search my pocket and hand one of the beef jerky from Rumman to Merrymel.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Huh, this is… ? this!!

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I think I already heard the story. There is really delicious beef jerky out there!

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Oh my goodness, such delicious food... .(Exclamation)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. I'm not eating that... . Is it already too late?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: (Merimel doesn’t seem to be listening.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha… , okay. I'll give you a few more.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Hmm, hmm. Since you have shown me sincerity, I will tell you where Medea is.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Medea will be in front of the large tree at the very back. I think it would be a bit uncomfortable for a foreigner to show up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it because of the Deimos Church?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Yes, that's right. The Deimos Church is hunting our clan. They say it has special powers... . I don't know what they do with that power, but many people were sacrificed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The reason I live a life cut off from the outside world is because of the Deimos Church.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But is there a reason you hate foreigners like me? It feels so hostile... .

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: You don't know. We basically look different from ordinary humans. For that reason alone, I had a hard time for a long time.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: We are humans too. But outsiders don't acknowledge it.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: There may be people who don't, but usually there are many people who don't admit anything else.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: We just look a little different, but it was always difficult because there were people who didn't think of us as human beings. Even if it’s not necessarily the Deimos Church… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe so. sorry. My thoughts were short.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: It's okay. Thank you for knowing that much... .

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: That's why Mediah may be trying hard to stop the members from going outside.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Now that I think about it, you said you came from Tartarus, right? Noel… . Oh, no. Then go to Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then, I will bring you the foreign items later without forgetting them.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Well, then, if possible, I would like beef jerky, please!! And if you have time, would you like to come back later?

steps.name: girl who lost her memory
steps.objective: In "Adrica", defeat [Flag Agnus] and [Sleepy Tremende] and report to [Minuet].

lines.text: (A faint but strong power is felt from the woman holding a special-looking cane. The woman is clearly looking uncomfortable.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello… do? Are you Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, I am Medea of the Kali clan. It's been a while since a foreigner came all this way to see me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then the story will be faster. The reason I came here... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Seeing that the condition of the Land of Illusion has worsened, soldiers from the Deimos Church have arrived.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We'll just hold our breath and wait for them to leave, just like we always do.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Go back. Foreigner. I don't trust you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No matter how much you are favored by the goddess, there is nothing I can do for you. Even if I give you my strength, it might be of help to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't tell you everything, how much do you know?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I can feel Shinick’s energy from you. The power of the ominous curse owner who cannot die... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Of course, I know that Shinik sent you because he cared about me. However, I hope you understand that I cannot justly accept the opinions of outsiders.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wait, you… . There must be something more important than coming to see me right now, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Today can't be... . Ah, have you ever seen someone wandering around Adrica, the land of illusion?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, there was a girl who was already wandering, so I gave her directions to Tartarus.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He… . No, that person may not be able to escape the Land of Illusion.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As the soldiers of the Deimos Church hunted the phantom beast, the earth lost control of itself.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Phantom beasts and phantom plants began to recognize aliens as threats to the land and life, and absorbed the power of those recognized.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The absorbed power also included their memories. I was prevented from remembering everything until I died, wandering forever in the land of illusion.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The foreigners who die in this way return to the ground and become food for the returning water and welcoming plants.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Up, it’s dangerous!! But how was I able to pass by? I'm sure I should have done the same... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Since he is a person who does the work of a goddess, he could have escaped… . This is not the time to be like this. Go right away and check on ‘Him’.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If that's the case, go to 'Dragon Valley' and ask Adkina for help. Adkina is probably going through difficulties right now... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As you go, clear out the beings that are disturbing the land of illusion. We need to hurry… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then I'll go right away.

steps.name: shadow in the valley
steps.objective: Defeat [Phantasmal Beast Kyrie] in “Dragon Valley” and go to [Adkina] in the very innermost part of “Dragon Valley”.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet!! minuet!!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Oh, I'm here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. Thanks to you, I survived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness. Nothing much happened... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: As you said, I came back here again. No, I ended up coming back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What does that mean? You came back??

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I walked in the direction of the village to get away from this place, but every time I did so, I lost consciousness.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: When I came to my senses again, it was always here... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: As if I can't leave this place... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? Then I'll grab the minuet and go!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (No matter which way you turn while holding on to the minuet, the minuet returns to its original position.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of phenomenon is this? ?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Am I right? So it’s a bit frustrating.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is there some kind of curse? It’s frustrating.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A person named Medea told me to go to the Valley of the Dragon if Minuet was in the same situation... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: The owner of this land... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Minuet’s expression seems to have changed slightly.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Ad… Kina… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. I feel a little tired. I feel like I'm falling asleep... . I will endure it somehow. That's strange.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I should go see him... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, wait here. I will somehow find a way to meet Adkina. Please wait. Still, it seems safe here...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes… , thank you… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (Minuet seems to be very tired and falls asleep, leaning against a rock.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll have to hurry. It's safe here, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Obviously, it all started with Shinik's request to tell the Kali people that it was dangerous... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This might be... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Let's leave the useless thoughts aside later.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The darkness that was holding Kyrie back has retreated. When was the last time the Valley of the Dragon was so filled with darkness? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina, nice to meet you. I am… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Introduce yourself briefly to Adkina.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Iris I heard that a follower of the Goddess came to this continent, and it was you. Thanks to you, the darkness in the Valley of the Dragon has disappeared.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I had a guess that you would come here someday. Still, I didn't want to meet you like this... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's a shame. It's like I, the owner, have to be trapped in my own territory because of the phantom beasts steeped in darkness... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The soldiers of the Deimos Church seemed to be quiet, but then they came here to hunt the phantom beasts and the Kali people.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The power of the phantom beast and the Kali tribe is being used somewhere, but it is frustrating because it is not yet clear where exactly it is being used.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Come to think of it, I didn't hear why you came here. What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He tells Adkina everything from collecting superhuman powers to Minuet, a girl who got lost in Adrica.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Wait, is He in the Land of Illusion? You're losing your memory... , Adrika is in danger now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know the minuet?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I know. I wish you could go and meet him instead of me and awaken his memory. If you don't do it, I don't know what will happen... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Adrica is dangerous. Please bring back his memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of person is Minuet? And what should I do?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It would be quicker to meet in person. And greet me with the one you follow. That would be the fastest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it might be difficult to talk about it because Iris doesn't have enough power yet.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: (Adkina extends one hand toward the sky. After a while, a clear and clean wind passes through Adkina's hand and passes by %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Iris You and the power you need. Let’s call it ‘fragment of memory’ to make it easier to understand. And I passed on some of my power to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Adkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Iris I will greet you separately from you, so hurry up and meet him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, yes... . But is it okay to just go?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The fragments of memory that the phantom beasts possess have already melted into the tips of your fingers. So hold his hand.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: As someone who followed the master of the moon, flowers, and plants, I promise you this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm sure we met at some point, but why can't I remember...?)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I will begin the purification of the Land of Illusion, so help him first. Oh, and… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Won't you come visit me after everything is over here? It's not urgent. I will tell you a story related to your memory.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Then I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: (As the back of %s disappears leaving the Dragon Valley, the shape of Iris appears blurry in front of Adkina.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hello, Adkina… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Nice to meet you. Iris Goddess. You look exactly like Ceres and that child.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If you say it's that kid... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: A being whom Ceres cherished and called ‘Der’… . He was also a distant ancestor of the goddess... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you, Adkina. For remembering her… . I have a lot to talk about with Adkina, but could you please wait a moment?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The darkness has not yet retreated from the Land of Illusion. And sinners too... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: If you are a sinner... , is it who I guess is correct?

steps.name: the goddess' abode
steps.objective: Defeat [Requiem] at “God’s Tree Lapier” and obtain <Crystal of a Forgotten World>. Then report to [Minuet] in “Adrica”.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: %s… , you are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. I feel like things are getting clearer here little by little and I'm feeling better.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness. Would you like to hold my hand first?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes? Hands?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A person named Adkina told me how to change Minuet's memory, and he said that all I had to do was hold his hand... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Believe it or not, but let's give it a try.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (Minuet nods and holds %s's hand. After a while, a clear and clean wind blows from somewhere and passes by their hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A pleasant wind… Huh, minuet?!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Subsequently, a sharp wind blew and I lost Minuet's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, are you okay?!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'm fine, %s… . Thanks to you, I got my memories back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. Then, I will guide you to a nearby village.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I don't think you need to do that. And let me introduce myself again. I am… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (In front of the minuet, a mysterious light that has never been seen in Adrica, the land of illusion, begins to spread.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this light... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like I'm going blind. I quickly raise one arm and cover my eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's like... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: %s… , look at me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Minuet's voice seemed to have changed slightly. When I raised my head and looked ahead, there was a person standing there who resembled Minuet, but was completely different.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … you are?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you. Thanks to you, I was able to regain my memories. My name is Gaia... . We created the earth together for our younger sister Ceres, who loved this world... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (Suddenly, I feel Gaia's presence clearly in my mind. Her name seems to be imprinted along with the light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia, Goddess of Earth... . Gaia?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I didn't want to meet you like this... . A long time ago, I exhausted all my strength trying to protect the continent and fell asleep and woke up repeatedly.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Since it couldn't expend much power, it would occasionally move around in human form. The current minuet is my incarnation as a human being.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: This time, when I woke up and looked around the land of illusions, I encountered a deep and evil darkness. So, while I was on my way to consult with Adkina, I stopped… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: It’s okay to call him a weak god. It's all my fault... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It would be extremely dangerous for a god in human form to lose his memory.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. Some of my memories have returned, but my strength hasn't returned properly... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't need to be sorry.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: While I was wandering around losing my memory, my space in the Land of Illusion was being invaded by a being that wielded darkness, and Adkina was also trapped.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, Gaia. So what can I do?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Could you please check inside my residence, ‘Lappier’? I don't know what the situation is like in my current state... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will come back.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Please be careful… .
(In the depths of Lapier, the Tree of God. A man is with an ominous being. Their eyes meet for a moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If a being with ominous power entered this sacred place, the goddess' abode...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's definitely an enemy. Considering they invaded this place, it doesn't seem like they're ordinary humans...)
It's annoying.
Put it away… … .
(As soon as the suspicious man finishes speaking, an ominous being nearby comes forward.)
Helper of God, 'Requiem', a requiem worthy of death, will guide you, so welcome it willingly... .
Interesting. Requiem ends like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whoa, whoa…. Whoa. It was hard. I felt like I was going to die….)
It's a pity, but I'll postpone your death until later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are you going!! What on earth are you planning here?!
(He rushes towards the suspicious man, but is blocked by a strange barrier and cannot get closer. Rather, a strange force approaches and begins to strangle his entire body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, ugh, ugh!!
Interesting. Helping God for nothing... . You seem to believe that this world will be maintained properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, what does that mean? Argh!! Wow... .
(Every time the suspicious man shakes his finger, tremendous pain is etched throughout his body.)
Go and tell the god you believe in. The world loved by a weak god will soon disappear. With the power of this ‘binding’… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this power ‘binding’?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaa!!
Is this enough to scare you? .
(As soon as the suspicious man stops moving his hands, the pain that was tormenting his entire body disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, huh... . eww… … . Ugh… .
In return for enduring the pain, I will tell you my name. My name is Weiss. A being that the lives of this earth curse like that... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: And those who have no choice but to commit sin... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: (Vice stares at %s, who has fallen and is suffering. Then he smiles softly.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Then we wait for the day when we can meet again. It would be possible if you were still alive on this earth by then... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: (Vice is no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about? The world is disappearing... .  Oh, I need to let you know… . Ugh, ugh… . First, let's go to Gaia.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Welcome… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: (The minuet slowly changes into the form of Gaia. The girl who wandered around Adrica without her memory is nowhere to be found.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thanks to you, the darkness in Lapier has disappeared. I can't feel the darkness in Adrica either.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank you. I think I can go back to Lapier now. But %s, your expression doesn't look good. Can you tell me what's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Gaia what happened at Lapier, the Tree of God.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Just a moment. vise… ?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Vice was there?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: It was all his fault that brought the evil darkness here.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Moreover, this object is from another world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something from another world... … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly a strange feeling surrounds my entire body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This feeling came when I met Vice... . Yes, fear… . It's fear. I've never really felt anything like fear... , why on earth… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go, Gaia… . Who is Vice? Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Poor %s. This is all… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: (Suddenly, Gaia's voice is no longer heard. Soon, vision becomes blurred and Gaia is no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's dark... . Where am I? I can't see anything... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: You're calling us here... . After all, you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is here, Gaia… ?
It's been a while. Your name was Gaia, I guess... .
(The low voice of an old man is heard from somewhere. A tremendous amount of pressure is felt in each word.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (My legs are so weak that I can't get up. When I look up and look at Gaia, her face is completely frozen.)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: As expected, Gaia does not welcome me. It's okay though.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: This world where even the gods fled as absurd chaos and dark power struck... .

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: It certainly seems like destruction isn't far away, but it's amazing that it's still holding on. There was a gift I once sent to this world.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Do you remember the bird that destroyed itself? The slave who was created with no choice but to be controlled by darkness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That’s….)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: The flame was extinguished for one human being... . Even those humans who follow the new god would know that story.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Oh, I guess you're asleep and don't notice... , something like that happened. Then let's stop talking about this.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: There's something I'd like to ask. So what about you?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Are humans and this world worth enough to exhaust all your power?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Now, see. After you fell asleep, did the world go the way you wanted it to? .

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: It's really funny that a weak god who can't even handle the existence of the devil is waiting for a savior without doing anything.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I know you won't answer anyway. Because I didn't want it in the first place.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Even if you are not the Demon King, your world will disappear someday. Because there are people who want that. Don't forget that I am one of them.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I've already sent something to destroy you, the life you care about, and the world you care about.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: It's a gift I sent after putting a lot of thought into it.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Please stop. stop!!

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Even if you tell me that, I can't stop. Don't you know from the beginning that your role and mine are bound to be like that?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I was originally going to invite just you, but it just so happened that that person came too.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: The girl who followed Ceres from human to god assimilated a human. and… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Don't touch him!! If you touch even a single hair, I won’t let you go!! You can't do anything other than scare them anyway!!

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: This is ridiculous, Gaia. What can you do when you have no strength and are just sleeping?!

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Well, I guess I'll stop here for today.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Same goes for me... .

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: If you meet Ceres someday, say hello. The world I cherished so much has disappeared without a trace. Hahahahaha… .

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: (The old man's voice disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This world is disappearing... , what kind of nonsense is that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The mind I was barely able to hold on to was fading due to the raw force that continued to press down on my head and shoulders.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry, Ceres... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Sorry, Iris. Sorry, %s… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: (Gaia's voice gets quieter and louder and can no longer be heard.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: (Minuet's worried appearance is visible through the field of vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here… ?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: (The girl who was Minuet changes into that of Gaia.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry... . The only thing a weak god can say is this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The old man… . I once saw the memorial of the person the old man sent. It was the voice I heard there, and hearing it like this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who the hell is that old man?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. There is nothing I can say right now. You'll find out when the time comes... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Can you understand?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. I understand because there are circumstances that everyone cannot talk about. Even if it's God... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank you, %s… . The darkness has retreated and the purification ritual started by Adkina has ended, so you can go back.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Now that you leave here, you won't be able to see me again for a while. If I use my power, I might fall asleep again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will we ever be able to meet again?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Even though I can't give you a definite answer, I can still promise you one thing.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I will set up a minuet so that we can have a conversation the moment you come here.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: The minuet is my incarnation, a part of it, but it is connected to me. Now Minuet will only be visible to you, so come and talk to me if you need to.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: %s, go to Medea and Shinik and tell them my story. Then they will naturally know what happened.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank you. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Gaia is gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, minuet… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: If you have any favors to ask Gaia later or want to talk, please come to me here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I got it. However, can we view Minuet as a separate person from the goddess?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Hmm… . If it's the same, it's the same. If it's different, it's different.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I know somehow. Gaia… sir?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: When it looks like this, you can call it a minuet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, minuet. By the way, is it okay if I just go without Gaia helping me meet Iris?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: By now, you may be meeting separately in ways we don't know about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I guess so. See you next time, Minuet… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Okay, see you next time.

steps.name: light and shadow
steps.objective: Visit [Shainic] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're still giving me uncomfortable looks.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry if you felt that way. And the goddess has returned with the welcoming energy of the earth. The remnants of the Deimos Church also disappear... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Although Gaia did not come in person, she told us what happened and how.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, so that’s what it meant….)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Oh, I'll be the same as I've always been.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I want to ask you something. Is it okay if it's not rude?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. What kind of question is this?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Do you think that what you are doing for God is the right way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Until now, I have never thought about anything else. I came this far just with the intention of meeting Iris. Of course, there were times when it was difficult.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You came all this way just for Iris.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. That was a good answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I have more questions... , is that all?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, that is a sufficient answer. Because I knew that you were that kind of person.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I can't say for sure, but I think I can trust you a little. So until trust is perfect... Please come visit often.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Maybe… , If that time comes, I might talk about something else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It has a positive meaning. To be trustworthy… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And one more thing… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There is light and shadow in everything. Just as light is not good and darkness is not evil. Remember, this also applies to the power you have and the work you do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Light and shadow... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you're on your way back, please say hello to Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well done. %s! It was fun thanks to you! Hahahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As expected, this time, I think he found out without me having to tell him.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's right. Because I came to know it to some extent through his influence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, didn't you guess what was going to happen before I went?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Half I knew, half I didn't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is one half and what is the other half?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's a secret. By the way, how do you feel about meeting him? Originally, I was going to introduce it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it just that there is one more person I know?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's a boring answer. And there's another person I met.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For a moment, his face comes to mind and my body trembles. My first moment of fear since coming to Eastland...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean Vice... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: How was it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You're scared. Anyone who has experienced his power can certainly do that. Because he is as close to absolute evil as Deimos, the twisted man who is the god of fear and war... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You'll be seeing Vice a lot now. If he makes a move, something big might happen soon.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Did I unintentionally scare you too much? Ahahaha. It won't be easy anymore. Neither you nor the god you serve must ever back down. Okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. If you rest, if you rest a little, you will be fine. Just rest a little... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay, don't overdo it... . But, you won't be able to rest for long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… , Then I’ll go.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Shainik stares at %s as he returns to his dorm helplessly.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well, I guess nothing much will happen with this for a while. However, the gods are not doing their part... . Okay, that’s not fun.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melbig.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes, Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Tell that to the beast in the hat. He is ‘real’ just like you guys… .
